- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:(six new test_stall_judge_live_review_runs_* functions appended after the `if __name__ == "__main__"` guard) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The six new `test_stall_judge_live_review_runs_*` tests, and their helpers, are defined after `raise SystemExit(main())`, so `main()` runs before they exist and reports "unknown test name".
  WHY: CI runs the file as a script, so the shard with any new test exits non-zero and the `orchestrate-poll` check fails. The source labels this BLOCKER; it is mapped to critical.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24905-24912 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_sj_merged_outcomes` concatenates cached entries (with `head_sha: ""`) before live entries, so `unique_by(.id)` keeps the cached copy and drops the live copy's real `headSha`.
  WHY: Diagnostics show an empty `head_sha` for in-progress review runs, which contradicts the prompt and README. Severity disagreement: gemini said MAJOR, and the other four said NIT. gemini also claimed `review_waiting_for_runner` is affected, but the other reviewers said waiting-run detection reads the live list directly and is unaffected.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24885-24899 (with scripts/gh_helpers.sh:4760-4764) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_sj_review_waiting_run` treats `queued`, `waiting`, `pending` and `requested` as waiting, but `is_wedged_queued` age-filters only `queued`.
  WHY: A same-head review run stuck in `waiting`, `pending` or `requested` holds `escalate_human` and `close_and_reissue` indefinitely, and every tick posts another Stall Judge comment. The "wedged-queued filter bounds the hold" comment overstates the bound.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1678-1688, 3063-3067 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_LINKED_PR_ENABLED` parse treats only the literal `false` as off, while the stall-judge switch accepts `false|0|no|off`.
  WHY: An operator who sets `0`, `no` or `off` finds the linked-PR lookup still running.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:1215-1224 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `LINKED_PR_REFUSED_VERDICTS` block sits between the #6557 comment and the `TERMINAL_VERDICT` check that the comment describes.
  WHY: There is no runtime failure, but the comment now reads as if it explained the linked-PR refusal.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:3018-3022 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The linked-PR diff fetch swallows failures with `|| true` and logs nothing when the diff is empty.
  WHY: A failed fetch cannot be told apart from a legitimately empty diff. anthropic raised this only as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
